## 11. Encashment of EL during L TC  
[ Swamy's FR & SR -  
Part-Ill ]  
1. Encashment of earned leave while availing LTC.--Will be admissible subject to the following conditions.-
1. Limited to 10 days of earned leave on one occasion- without linkage to the number of days and nature of leave availed and 60 days in the entire career.  
- be deducted while computing the maximum admissible
2. Will not for encashment at the time of quitting service.
